_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: 'among'/'last' low-rank continuation ↔ 'ahead/despite' prepositional continuation
axes.rationale: The logit and tuned lenses put ' among'/' amongst'/' среди' at the negative end, and real-logit correlation adds ' among', ' last', ' out' and ' of' there. The Jacobian negative end carries pejoratives (' worse', ' useless', ' crappy') that fit a poor or last rank. The positive end favours ' ahead', ' following', ' despite', ' behind', ' to' and ' for'.

axes.label: 'while/with' clause continuation ↔ 'last/this/among' ranking qualifier
axes.rationale: Real-logit correlation splits ' while', ' with', ' after', ' overall' (negative) from ' last', ' this', ' among', ' behind', ' Sunday' (positive). The Jacobian partly agrees, with ' whilst'/' Whilst' negative and emphatic ' EVERY', ' ONLY', ' honored' positive. The logit and tuned lenses look like noise.

axes.label: 'that/despite/behind' ↔ 'of/from/after' function-word continuation
axes.rationale: Only real-logit correlation shows any structure, contrasting ' that', ' behind', ' despite', ' out' with ' of', ' from', ' but', ' after'. The lenses give subword fragments (uset, irth, odelist) and, in the Jacobian, dash tokens, with no clear concept.
